skill.name: lark-vc
skill.description: Search completed Lark video meetings, retrieve participant snapshots, and locate notes, transcripts, recordings, summaries, tasks, and chapters through lark-cli.
skill.summary: Find completed Lark meetings and retrieve their authorized records and artifacts.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: One static finding is confirmed because SKILL.md mandates loading instructions from outside the audited package; the other 129 detections are syntax false positives. A separate medium finding covers live bot join guidance inside the read-only historical search reference. No encoded payload, host reconnaissance, credential theft, or data exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: The skill mandates loading instruction content outside its audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the required authentication guidance here, or pin an independently audited dependency without a mandatory parent-directory read.

remediation.issue: The historical search reference includes live bot join and leave guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Remove lines 83-91 or move them to lark-vc-agent, where live participation can require explicit user confirmation.

content.user_title: Search and Review Lark Video Meetings
content.value_statement: Finding reliable records across completed Lark meetings can require several tools and identifiers. This skill routes searches, participant checks, transcripts, notes, and recordings through lark-cli.
actual_capabilities: Searches completed meetings by keyword, date range, organizer, participant, or room.
Retrieves meeting details, including note identifiers and recording tokens.
Returns authorized participant snapshots for completed meetings.
Routes requests to notes, transcripts, summaries, tasks, chapters, and recording metadata.
Follows pagination when users request complete result sets or statistics.
limitations: It does not search future schedules; those requests require the Lark calendar skill.
It does not join live meetings or process real-time meeting events.
It requires lark-cli authentication and the user's existing Lark permissions.
Some meetings have no transcript, note, or recording because those features were not enabled.

use_cases.title: Review Project Decisions
use_cases.description: Find a completed project meeting and summarize decisions, unresolved points, and assigned actions from its transcript.

use_cases.title: Verify Meeting Attendance
use_cases.description: Retrieve an authorized participant snapshot and identify who attended a completed meeting.

use_cases.title: Collect Meeting Artifacts
use_cases.description: Locate notes, transcript links, recording details, summaries, tasks, and chapters for a selected meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Completed Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my completed Lark meetings about [topic] between [start date] and [end date]. Show the date, organizer, and participants.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search with a topic and date range

prompt_templates.title: Check Participants
prompt_templates.prompt: For the completed meeting [meeting name or ID], list the participant snapshot and note each available join or leave time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Attendance review for a known meeting

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Meeting Artifacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [meeting name], then return available note, transcript, recording, summary, task, and chapter links without downloading media.
prompt_templates.scenario: Artifact collection with controlled side effects

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Full Meeting Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Search all completed [project] meetings during [period], follow every page, and compare transcript evidence for decisions, owners, deadlines, and unresolved issues.

output_examples.input: Find completed Atlas reviews from last week.
output: Three completed meetings matched the date range and Atlas keyword.
Each result includes its date, organizer, participants, and available artifacts.
Two meetings have transcripts; one has only participant and title data.

output_examples.input: Who attended the selected launch review?
output: The authorized participant snapshot lists eight attendees.
Six attendees have join and leave times; two have only attendance records.

output_examples.input: Summarize decisions and actions from this meeting.
output: The transcript supports three decisions and four assigned actions.
Each action includes its owner and deadline when stated.
Unresolved questions are separated from confirmed decisions.

best_practices: Provide a date range, participant, organizer, room, or genuine meeting keyword.
Confirm the intended meeting when several search results have similar titles.
Use transcript evidence for independent analysis and request AI summaries only when needed.
anti_patterns: Do not use historical meeting search for future schedules.
Do not assume the first result page contains every matching meeting.
Do not expose meeting identifiers, tokens, transcripts, or participant data beyond the intended audience.

faq.question: Can this skill find future meetings?
faq.answer: No. It searches completed meetings. Use the Lark calendar skill for future schedules.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: The user must authenticate lark-cli and hold Lark permissions for each requested meeting or artifact.

faq.question: Can it summarize a meeting?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze an available transcript or return an existing AI summary when requested.

faq.question: Can it show who attended?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve the authorized participant snapshot for a completed meeting.

faq.question: Can it join or leave a live meeting?
faq.answer: No. Live participation and real-time events belong to the separate lark-vc-agent skill.

faq.question: What happens when no transcript exists?
faq.answer: It reports the missing artifact and limits conclusions to available titles, participant data, notes, or recording metadata.
